environment.description: Django REST API deployed on EC2 instance with MongoDB 6.0 Atlas cluster. ProductDetailView endpoint is exposed publicly on port 443 via nginx reverse proxy. No request body validation middleware. Authentication is optional (AllowAny permission class). MongoDB user has readWrite permissions on the products database.

config.network: Public ALB -> nginx -> gunicorn on port 8000
config.mongodb: Atlas M10 cluster, readWrite role, no field-level encryption
config.middleware: Standard Django middleware stack, no custom request sanitization
